compiled_state.title: migrate-story-pr-bases.sh triggers deleted per-branch-review.yml workflow (runtime 404)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description
plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-story-pr-bases.sh line 105 runs: gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml --ref "${head_ref}"

The workflow was deleted in commit 4b18d2d644 (story 20d7-09d6). This call will return a GitHub API 404 at runtime.

Additionally, plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh is a dedicated helper for per-branch-review.yml's diff-base resolution and now has no caller — it is dead code.

## Impact
P2 — runtime failure in migrate-story-pr-bases.sh; dead code in resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh.

## Fix
1. Remove the gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml call from migrate-story-pr-bases.sh (replace with no-op or ci.yml-equivalent trigger).
2. Delete or repurpose resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh and its tests (tests/scripts/test-resolve-per-branch-review-base.sh, tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh).

## Found By
completion-verifier during story 20d7-09d6 closure
